title: Baltimore Officers Open Fire After Suspect Shoots At Patrol Cars
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Baltimore, Maryland — On Thursday, May 14, 2026, at approximately 9:12 a.m., officers with the Baltimore Police Department (BPD) received a 911 call for an armed individual, later identified as 46-year-old Louis Jackson in the 800 block of Caton Avenue. Officer Sharod Watson driving in the area encountered Jackson on foot in the 3300 block of Wilkens Avenue, and notified dispatch that the man fired a shot at his patrol car. Officer Watson exited his cruiser and issued commands. Jackson ignored the commands and continued firing at officers. Officer Watson and Officer Mark Rankine discharged their firearms, striking Jackson. Officers rendered aid until emergency medical services assumed care. Jackson was transported to a nearby hospital, where he was pronounced dead a short time later. A handgun was recovered at the scene near Jackson. No officers were injured during the incident.
